body: @mkouba The implemented solution explicitly checks if the type is String, but raw/safe are extensions of Object, and applies to the toString() value of it. Given the following usage: ``` return template.data("obj", List.of("Hello", "World")); ``` ``` {obj} {obj.raw} ``` will produce as expected: ``` [<i>Hello</i>, <b>World</b>] [Hello, World] ``` But: ``` {@java.lang.Object obj} {obj} {obj.raw} ``` will error out with: ``` [1] Incorrect expression: obj.raw - property/method [raw] not found on class [java.lang.Object] nor handled by an extension method - found in template [hello.html] on line 3 ```

issue.title: Qute - declaring a parameter of type java.lang.Object causes NullPointerException
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
The following template:
```
{@java.lang.Object obj}
{obj.toString()}
```

causes a BuildException caused by a NullPointerException:
